chunks: Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad al-Hannat, who said:

Abu Abdillah عليه السلام was asked about a man who instructed another man to marry a woman for him in al-Madinah, specifying her to him, while the one who instructed him was in al-'Iraq. The one instructed went out and married her to him, then came to al-'Iraq and found that the one who had instructed him had died.

He عليه السلام said: "That should be examined. If the instructed person married her to him before the one giving the instruction died, and then the one giving the instruction died afterward, then the dowry in all of that is from the inheritance in the position of a debt. But if he married her to him after the one giving the instruction had died, then there is nothing upon the one giving the instruction nor upon the one instructed, and the marriage is invalid."

key_terms.ٱلدَّيْنِ: a debt, meaning a financial liability due from the estate
key_terms.ٱلْمَأْمُورُ: the person instructed or appointed to carry out the marriage contract
key_terms.ٱلْمَهْرَ: the bridal dower owed to the wife
key_terms.ٱلْمِيرَاثِ: the estate or inheritance left by the deceased

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone appoints another person to contract a marriage for him, but dies before the agent returns?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a marriage contract carried out through an agent when the principal dies. If the marriage was concluded before the principal's death, the marriage stands and the mahr is treated as a debt against the estate; if concluded after his death, the contract is invalid and no liability is established. It is significant for questions of agency, marriage validity, and financial obligations tied to inheritance.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4489 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Abu Walad al-Hannat, who said:

Abu Abdillah (as) was asked about a man who instructed another man to marry a woman for him in Medina, specifying her by name, while the one giving the instruction was in Iraq. The one instructed went and married her to him. Then he returned to Iraq and found that the one who had given the instruction had died.

Imam (as) said: "It should be examined. If the instructed person married her to him before the one who gave the instruction died, and then the one who gave the instruction died afterward, then the dowry in all such cases will be considered part of the inheritance, like a debt. But if he married her to him after the one who gave the instruction had died, then there is no obligation on the one who gave the instruction nor on the one who carried it out, and the marriage is invalid."
